design_guidelines.md.content:
# Design Guidelines for Brittany Chiang Portfolio Replica

## Design Approach
**Exact Reference-Based Design**: This is a pixel-perfect replica of Brittany Chiang's portfolio (brittanychiang.com). Every design decision must match the original site precisely - colors, typography, spacing, layout, and interactions.

## Color Palette (Exact Match Required)
- **Background**: Very dark navy (#0a192f or similar)
- **Secondary Background**: Slightly lighter navy (#112240)
- **Text Primary**: Light slate gray (#ccd6f6)
- **Text Secondary**: Muted slate (#8892b0)
- **Accent/Highlight**: Teal/cyan (#64ffda)
- **Hover States**: Lighter teal with subtle glow
- **Links**: Teal accent color
- **Borders/Dividers**: Subtle navy (#233554)

## Typography System
- **Font Family**: Inter (via Google Fonts)
- **Heading Hierarchy**:
  - Name/Hero: 60-80px, bold, slate color
  - Section Titles: 28-32px, bold, light slate
  - Job Titles: 18-20px, medium weight
  - Body Text: 16-18px, regular
- **Line Height**: 1.6 for body, 1.2 for headings
- **Letter Spacing**: Tight for headings (-0.02em), normal for body

## Layout Structure

### Fixed Left Navigation (Desktop)
- Sticky sidebar on left (~25% width)
- Contains: Name, short bio, navigation menu (About, Experience, Projects, Writing)
- Social icons at bottom (GitHub, LinkedIn, etc.)
- Smooth opacity transitions on scroll

### Main Content Area (Right)
- Occupies ~75% width with max-width constraint
- Sections flow vertically with generous spacing (py-24)
- Each section has subtle fade-in on scroll

### Spacing System
Use Tailwind units: 4, 6, 8, 12, 16, 24 for consistent rhythm

## Core Sections

### About Section
- Large introductory paragraph with highlighted links (teal underline on hover)
- Technology mentions inline with accent color
- Personal details with subtle storytelling tone

### Experience Section
- Timeline-style layout with connecting lines
- Each job entry:
  - Company name (teal) with external link icon
  - Job title and date range (muted)
  - Description paragraph
  - Technology tags (pills with dark background, teal border)
  - Full card has subtle hover effect (slight lift + background color change to lighter navy)
- "View Full Résumé" link at bottom

### Projects Section
- Grid layout (2 columns on desktop, 1 on mobile)
- Project cards with:
  - Large featured image (rounded corners, subtle border)
  - Project title (teal, links to live site)
  - Description text
  - GitHub stars count with icon
  - Technology tags (same style as Experience)
  - Image has subtle zoom on card hover
- "View Full Project Archive" link at bottom

### Writing Section
- 3-column grid of blog post cards (1 column mobile)
- Each card:
  - Small thumbnail image (icon/illustration style)
  - Year badge (small, muted)
  - Title (linked, teal on hover)
  - Entire card is clickable with hover lift effect

## Component Patterns

### Navigation Links
- Default: Muted slate
- Hover: Teal with smooth transition
- Active section: Teal with indicator line on left

### External Link Icons
- Small arrow/external icon after links
- Appears on hover with slide-in animation
- Teal color matching link

### Technology Tags
- Dark background with teal border
- Rounded pills (fully rounded)
- Small text (14px)
- Flex wrap layout

### Hover Interactions
- Cards: Subtle lift (translateY -4px) + background lightening
- Links: Color change to teal + underline slide-in
- Images: Slight scale (1.05) with smooth transition
- All transitions: 200-300ms ease

## Images
**No large hero image** - This site uses typography-first approach

**Project Images**: 
- Featured project screenshots (1200x800px aspect)
- Clean UI screenshots showing the work
- Placed at top of each project card
- Examples: Spotify app interface, VS Code theme, portfolio screenshots

**Writing Thumbnails**:
- Small icon-style illustrations (400x400px)
- Abstract/symbolic representations
- Examples: Accessibility icon, telescope, headless horseman

## Mobile Responsive Behavior
- Navigation moves to top horizontal menu (hamburger optional)
- Single column layout for all sections
- Reduce spacing (py-12 instead of py-24)
- Stack project grid to 1 column
- Maintain all hover states as active states on mobile

## Special Elements
- "Skip to Content" link (accessibility)
- Smooth scroll behavior between sections
- Subtle scroll-triggered animations (fade + slide up)
- Footer with time travel easter egg (small spinning icon)
- Copyright and social links in footer

## Performance Notes
- Lazy load images
- Optimize font loading (swap strategy)
- Minimal animations for performance
- Use transform for animations (GPU accelerated)

replit.md.content:
# Portfolio Application - Meryem Erdoğdu

## Overview

This is a professional portfolio website for Meryem Erdoğdu, an AI & Software Development Enthusiast. The application is a single-page portfolio showcasing professional experience, featured projects, technical skills, certificates & achievements, current interests, and a professional blog. It emphasizes accessibility, responsive design, and smooth user interactions with a modern dark theme.

## Recent Updates (November 2025)

### Navigation & Layout Updates
- Fixed header alignment and spacing
- Adjusted navigation menu positioning with proper spacing (mt-20)
- Aligned social media icons with proper spacing (mt-8)
- Added introductory description text under the main title
- Centered header text temporarily, then reverted to left alignment

### Project Cards Enhancement
- Updated project cards to match experience card format with dates
- Added date ranges to all projects (format: MM.YYYY - MM.YYYY)
- Increased logo size from w-10/h-10 to w-12/h-12 for consistency
- Added image gallery support (3 small image boxes per project)
- Integrated stock images for all projects:
  - GreFins: Sustainability platform visuals
  - Finhens: Financial analytics dashboards
  - Ecozyon Tech: Eco technology and renewable energy
  - NASA Space Apps: Space technology and satellite imagery
- Removed "View Full Project Archive" link

### Responsive Design Fixes
- Fixed Interests section grid layout (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2)
- Added break-words to interest card titles to prevent overflow
- Improved mobile responsiveness across all sections

## User Preferences

Preferred communication style: Simple, everyday Turkish language.

## System Architecture

### Frontend Architecture

**Framework & Build System**
- **React 18** with TypeScript for type-safe component development
- **Vite** as the build tool and development server, providing fast hot module replacement (HMR)
- **Wouter** for lightweight client-side routing (replacing heavier alternatives like React Router)
- **React Query (@tanstack/react-query)** for server state management and data fetching

**UI Component System**
- **shadcn/ui** component library built on Radix UI primitives for accessible, unstyled components
- **Tailwind CSS** for utility-first styling with custom design tokens
- Component library follows the "new-york" style variant with extensive customization
- All components support dark mode by default (the only theme used)

**Design System**
- Custom CSS variables defined in `index.css` for consistent theming
- Color palette based on HSL values for precise dark navy backgrounds (#0a192f equivalent) and teal accents (#64ffda)
- Typography uses Inter font from Google Fonts with specific size and weight hierarchies
- Spacing follows Tailwind's standard scale (4, 6, 8, 12, 16, 24) for visual rhythm

**Layout Patterns**
- **Desktop**: Fixed left sidebar (25% width) with sticky navigation, main content area (75% width) on the right
- **Mobile**: Responsive stacked layout with sticky section headers
- Scroll-based section highlighting for active navigation state
- Radial gradient spotlight effect following mouse cursor position
- Smooth scroll behavior with proper scroll margin offsets

### Backend Architecture

**Server Framework**
- **Express.js** server with TypeScript for API endpoints
- Custom middleware for request logging with response capture
- Vite middleware integration for development with HMR support
- Static file serving in production mode

**Development vs Production**
- Development mode uses Vite dev server with full HMR capabilities
- Production mode serves pre-built static assets from `dist/public`
- Environment-aware configuration through `NODE_ENV`

**Storage Layer**
- In-memory storage implementation (`MemStorage`) as the default data layer
- Storage interface (`IStorage`) defines contract for CRUD operations
- User management with UUID-based IDs
- Designed to be swapped with database-backed storage (e.g., Drizzle ORM with PostgreSQL)

### Data Models

**Database Schema (Drizzle ORM)**
- **Users table**: Basic authentication structure with username/password fields
- UUID primary keys using PostgreSQL's `gen_random_uuid()`
- Schema validation using Zod through `drizzle-zod`
- Migration support configured for PostgreSQL dialect

**Type Safety**
- Shared schema types between frontend and backend via `shared/schema.ts`
- Inferred types from Drizzle schema definitions
- Zod validation schemas for runtime type checking

### State Management

**Client-side State**
- Local component state with React hooks (useState, useEffect)
- Active section tracking for navigation highlighting
- Mouse position tracking for spotlight effect
- Mobile detection through custom `useIsMobile` hook

**Server State**
- React Query for async data fetching (though minimal API usage in current implementation)
- Configured with disabled refetching to prevent unnecessary requests
- Infinite stale time for static portfolio content

### Styling Architecture

**Tailwind Configuration**
- Custom color system with HSL-based values and alpha channel support
- Extended border radius values for consistent component styling
- Custom CSS variables for elevation effects (`--elevate-1`, `--elevate-2`)
- Badge and button outline opacity variables
- Path aliases for cleaner imports (@/, @shared/, @assets/)

**Component Variants**
- Class Variance Authority (CVA) for type-safe variant management
- Button variants: default, destructive, outline, secondary, ghost
- Size variants: default, sm, lg, icon
- Hover and active state elevation through custom CSS classes

### Accessibility Features

- Semantic HTML structure with proper ARIA labels
- Skip-to-content link for keyboard navigation
- Screen reader-only text for visual elements
- Focus management with visible focus rings
- Proper heading hierarchy (h1-h3)
- Alt text for images and icons
- Keyboard-navigable interactive elements

### Performance Optimizations

- Code splitting through Vite's automatic chunking
- Lazy-loaded route components
- Optimized image loading with `loading="lazy"` attributes
- Minimal JavaScript bundle through tree-shaking
- CSS purging in production builds
- Static asset optimization

## External Dependencies

### UI Component Libraries
- **@radix-ui/***: Headless UI primitives for 25+ components (accordion, dialog, dropdown, etc.)
- **lucide-react**: Icon library for consistent iconography
- **cmdk**: Command palette component
- **embla-carousel-react**: Carousel/slider functionality
- **react-day-picker**: Calendar/date picker component
- **vaul**: Drawer component primitives

### Form Management
- **react-hook-form**: Form state management with validation
- **@hookform/resolvers**: Validation resolver adapters
- **zod**: Schema validation library

### Styling
- **tailwindcss**: Utility-first CSS framework
- **tailwind-merge**: Utility for merging Tailwind classes
- **clsx**: Conditional class name construction
- **class-variance-authority**: Type-safe variant API
- **autoprefixer**: CSS vendor prefixing

### Database & ORM
- **drizzle-orm**: TypeScript ORM for SQL databases
- **drizzle-kit**: CLI tool for migrations and schema management
- **@neondatabase/serverless**: Neon PostgreSQL serverless driver
- **drizzle-zod**: Zod schema generation from Drizzle schemas

### Utilities
- **date-fns**: Date manipulation and formatting
- **nanoid**: Unique ID generation

### Development Tools
- **tsx**: TypeScript execution for Node.js
- **esbuild**: Fast JavaScript bundler for production builds
- **@replit/vite-plugin-runtime-error-modal**: Error overlay for Replit environment
- **@replit/vite-plugin-cartographer**: Replit-specific development tool
- **@replit/vite-plugin-dev-banner**: Development banner plugin

### Fonts

# Portfolio Application - Meryem Erdoğdu

Professional AI/ML Software Developer Portfolio

## Tech Stack

- **Frontend**: React 18 + TypeScript + Vite
- **UI**: shadcn/ui + Tailwind CSS
- **Routing**: Wouter
- **Backend**: Express.js + TypeScript
- **Styling**: Tailwind CSS with custom dark theme

## Prerequisites

- Node.js (v18 or higher)
- npm or yarn

## Installation & Setup

### 1. Clone & Install Dependencies

```bash
npm install
```

### 2. Development Mode

```bash
npm run dev
```

The application will run on `http://localhost:5000`

### 3. Production Build

```bash
npm run build
npm start
```

## Visual Studio / VS Code Setup

### Recommended Extensions

- **ESLint**: Code linting
- **Prettier**: Code formatting
- **Tailwind CSS IntelliSense**: Tailwind class suggestions
- **TypeScript**: Built-in TypeScript support

### Project Structure

```
├── client/               # Frontend application
│   ├── src/
│   │   ├── components/  # React components
│   │   ├── pages/       # Page components
│   │   ├── lib/         # Utilities
│   │   └── hooks/       # Custom hooks
│   └── index.html
├── server/              # Backend Express server
│   ├── index.ts        # Server entry point
│   ├── routes.ts       # API routes
│   └── storage.ts      # Data storage
└── shared/             # Shared types & schemas
    └── schema.ts
```

### Available Scripts

- `npm run dev` - Start development server with hot reload
- `npm run build` - Build for production
- `npm start` - Start production server
- `npm run check` - TypeScript type checking

## Features

- ✨ Modern dark theme with purple accent color (#9B59B6)
- 🎨 Smooth mouse-following gradient light effect
- 📱 Fully responsive design
- ♿ Accessibility-focused
- 🚀 Fast performance with Vite
- 💼 Professional sections: About, Experience, Skills, Projects, Certificates, Interests

## Customization

### Theme Colors

Edit `client/src/index.css` to customize colors:

```css
--primary: 277 46% 55%;  /* Purple theme color */
```

### Content

Update components in `client/src/components/` to modify content:

- `AboutSection.tsx` - Personal info
- `ExperienceSection.tsx` - Work experience
- `SkillsSection.tsx` - Technical skills
- `ProjectsSection.tsx` - Featured projects
- `CertificatesSection.tsx` - Achievements
- `InterestsSection.tsx` - Current interests

## Troubleshooting

### Port already in use

Change the port in `server/index.ts`:

```typescript
const PORT = 5000; // Change to another port
```

### TypeScript errors

Run type checking:

```bash
npm run check
```

# Deployment Sorun Giderme

## ✅ Düzeltilen Hatalar

### GitHub Pages İçin
- ✅ Build komutu sadece frontend için optimize edildi
- ✅ Attached assets otomatik kopyalanacak
- ✅ `.nojekyll` dosyası eklendi
- ✅ Node.js 20 sürümü kullanılıyor

### Render.com İçin
- ✅ Build ve start komutları doğru ayarlandı
- ✅ Frankfurt bölgesi seçildi (Türkiye'ye en yakın)
- ✅ Free plan aktif

## 🔧 GitHub Pages Deployment

### Gereksinimler:
1. ✅ Repository public olmalı (veya GitHub Pro)
2. ✅ `main` veya `master` branch olmalı
3. ✅ Settings → Pages → Source: "GitHub Actions" seçili olmalı

### Adımlar:
```bash
# 1. Kodu yükle
git add .
git commit -m "GitHub Pages deployment fix"
git push origin main

# 2. GitHub'da Actions sekmesini kontrol et
# 3. Build tamamlanınca Pages ayarlarından URL'i al
```

### Olası Hatalar ve Çözümleri:

#### ❌ "Process completed with exit code 1"
**Çözüm:** Build loglarını kontrol edin
```bash
# Yerel test:
npx vite build
```

#### ❌ "Assets yüklenmiyor" (404)
**Çözüm:** Şimdi düzeltildi, assets otomatik kopyalanıyor

#### ❌ "Page not found after deployment"
**Çözüm:** 
- Repository Settings → Pages kontrol edin
- Branch doğru mu? (main/master)
- Source "GitHub Actions" seçili mi?

## 🔧 Render.com Deployment

### Adımlar:
1. GitHub'a kodu yükleyin
2. [render.com](https://render.com) → Login with GitHub
3. New → Web Service
4. Repository'nizi seçin
5. "Create Web Service" (ayarlar otomatik)

### Olası Hatalar ve Çözümleri:

#### ❌ "Build failed"
**Çözüm:** 
- `render.yaml` dosyası repo kökünde olmalı
- Build loglarını inceleyin

#### ❌ "Service unavailable"
**Çözüm:**
- 15 dakika hareketsizlikten sonra uyur (ücretsiz plan)
- İlk istek 30-50 saniye sürebilir
- Sayfayı yenileyin

#### ❌ "Health check failed"
**Çözüm:**
- Port 5000 kullanıldığından emin olun
- `server/index.ts` kontrol edin

## 🚀 En Kolay Yöntem: Replit Deployment

Eğer karmaşık geliyorsa:

1. Replit'te **"Deploy"** butonuna tıklayın
2. Deployment tipini seçin (Autoscale önerilir)
3. 2-3 dakika bekleyin
4. ✅ Hazır!

**Avantajları:**
- Zero configuration
- SSL otomatik
- Her zaman açık (ücretli planda)
- Tek tık deployment

## 📋 Kontrol Listesi

Deployment öncesi:

- [ ] `git add .` ve `git commit` yapıldı
- [ ] `git push origin main` yapıldı
- [ ] GitHub repository public
- [ ] `.github/workflows/deploy.yml` mevcut (GitHub Pages için)
- [ ] `render.yaml` mevcut (Render için)
- [ ] Yerel build test edildi: `npm run build`

## 🆘 Hala Sorun mu Var?

Hata mesajını paylaşın:
- GitHub Actions logları
- Render deployment logları
- Tarayıcı console hataları

---

**Önerilen Yöntem:** 

Başlangıç için **Replit Deployment** en kolay ve güvenilir yöntem. Deploy butonuna tıklamanız yeterli!

GITHUB_PAGES_SETUP.md.content:
# GitHub Pages Kurulum Talimatları

Bu dosya, portfolio sitenizi GitHub Pages'te yayınlamak için gereken adımları açıklar.

## Adım 1: GitHub Repository Ayarları

1. GitHub'da repository'nize gidin
2. **Settings** (Ayarlar) sekmesine tıklayın
3. Sol menüden **Pages** seçeneğini bulun
4. **Source** (Kaynak) bölümünde:
   - **GitHub Actions** seçin (Branch yerine)

## Adım 2: Kodu GitHub'a Push Edin

```bash
git add .
git commit -m "Add GitHub Pages deployment"
git push origin main
```

(Eğer ana dal `master` ise `main` yerine `master` yazın)

## Adım 3: Deployment'ı İzleyin

1. Repository'nizde **Actions** sekmesine gidin
2. "Deploy to GitHub Pages" workflow'unun çalıştığını göreceksiniz
3. Yeşil ✓ işareti çıktığında site yayında demektir
4. Site adresi: `https://KULLANICI-ADINIZ.github.io/REPO-ADINIZ/`

## Önemli Not

⚠️ **Backend çalışmaz**: GitHub Pages sadece static (HTML/CSS/JS) dosyaları barındırır. Express.js backend çalışmaz ama portfolio içeriği görünür.

## Sorun Giderme

### Site boş görünüyor
- Repository Settings → Pages'te doğru branch seçili mi kontrol edin
- Actions sekmesinde deployment başarılı mı kontrol edin
- Tarayıcı cache'ini temizleyin (Ctrl+Shift+R)

### 404 Hatası
- Repository ismi ve kullanıcı adınızı doğru yazdığınızdan emin olun
- URL'nin sonunda `/` olduğundan emin olun

## Alternatif Deployment Seçenekleri

Eğer backend'e ihtiyacınız varsa:

- **Replit Deployment**: En kolay, tek tık
- **Render.com**: Ücretsiz, GitHub entegrasyonu
- **Vercel**: Frontend için harika
- **Railway**: Full-stack için uygun

---

**Tüm dosyalar hazır!** Yukarıdaki adımları takip ederek siteniz GitHub Pages'te yayınlanacak.

RENDER_DEPLOYMENT.md.content:
# Render.com Deployment Talimatları

Backend'li portfolio sitenizi **ücretsiz** yayınlamak için adım adım rehber.

## 🎯 Render.com Nedir?

- ✅ Tam Node.js/Express desteği
- ✅ GitHub otomatik deployment
- ✅ Ücretsiz plan (750 saat/ay)
- ✅ SSL sertifikası otomatik
- ⚠️ 15 dakika hareketsizlikten sonra uyur (ilk istek 30 saniye sürebilir)

## 📋 Adım Adım Kurulum

### 1. Kodu GitHub'a Yükleyin

```bash
git add .
git commit -m "Render deployment hazır"
git push origin main
```

### 2. Render.com'a Kaydolun

1. [render.com](https://render.com) sitesine gidin
2. **GitHub ile Giriş Yap** tıklayın
3. GitHub hesabınızla bağlanın

### 3. Yeni Web Service Oluşturun

1. Dashboard'da **New** → **Web Service** tıklayın
2. GitHub repository'nizi bulun ve **Connect** yapın
3. Ayarlar otomatik gelecek (`render.yaml` sayesinde):
   - **Name**: meryem-portfolio (istediğiniz ismi yazabilirsiniz)
   - **Region**: Frankfurt
   - **Branch**: main (veya master)
   - **Build Command**: `npm install && npm run build`
   - **Start Command**: `npm start`
4. **Free Plan** seçili olsun
5. **Create Web Service** tıklayın

### 4. Deployment'ı İzleyin

- Deploy işlemi 3-5 dakika sürer
- Logs'tan ilerlemeyi izleyebilirsiniz
- ✅ "Your service is live" mesajı gelince hazır!

### 5. Sitenizi Ziyaret Edin

Site URL'niz: `https://meryem-portfolio.onrender.com` (veya seçtiğiniz isim)

## 🔄 Otomatik Deploy

Her GitHub push'ta Render otomatik deploy eder:

```bash
git add .
git commit -m "Site güncellendi"
git push origin main
# Render otomatik deploy başlar
```

## ⚡ Performans Notu

**Ücretsiz planda:**
- 15 dakika hareketsizlikten sonra uyur
- İlk ziyarette 30-50 saniye yükleme olabilir
- Sonraki istekler hızlı olur

**Çözüm:**
- Ücretli plana geçin ($7/ay) → Asla uyumaz
- Veya Replit Deployment kullanın

## 🆘 Sorun Giderme

### Build Hatası
- Render logs'u kontrol edin
- `package.json` dosyasının doğru olduğundan emin olun

### Site Açılmıyor
- Deployment tamamlanana kadar bekleyin
- Logs'ta hata var mı kontrol edin

### Environment Variables Gerekli
Settings → Environment → Add Environment Variable

---

## 🎉 Alternatif: Replit (Daha Kolay)

Eğer tüm bu adımlar karmaşık geliyorsa:

**Replit'te "View Deployments" butonuna tıklayın** → 1 dakikada hazır!

---

**Hazır!** GitHub'a push edin ve Render.com'da 3 adımda deploy edin.

    env: node
    region: frankfurt
    plan: free
    buildCommand: npm install && npm run build
    startCommand: npm start
    envVars:
      - key: NODE_ENV
        value: production
